['Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles', 'From activities', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', "Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id in ('CHEMBL2971', 'CHEMBL2835')", "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", "Filter activities.standard_units = 'nM'", 'Filter activities.value is not null', 'Filter activities.value < 50 and activities.value > 200', 'Group by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles', 'Having count(distinct target_dictionary.chembl_id) = 2', 'Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Limit 1000']
